screening_decisions.reason: Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled crossover trial of a systemic intervention (inosiplex) in alopecia totalis.
Randomized, placebo-controlled trial of systemic corticosteroid pulse therapy in extensive alopecia areata.
Prospective randomized controlled investigator-blinded trial comparing topical corticosteroids in mild-to-moderate AA.
Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled topical minoxidil trial in extensive AA, including AT and AU.
Double-blind allocation to minoxidil vs placebo initially (then switch) in extensive AA; RCT features present.
Randomized double-blind half-head design (minoxidil vs vehicle adjunct to DPCP) in severe AA; topical RCT.
Patients randomly assigned to topical cyclosporine, PUVA, or IV thymopentin; randomized comparative trial in AT/AU nonresponders.
Small within-patient application; randomization not stated and no randomized controlled design evident.
Randomized allocation to topical cyclosporin A vs vehicle; RCT in refractory AA.
Double-blind, placebo-controlled systemic antidepressant trial in AA; design implies randomization.
Randomly assigned to topical immunotherapy, systemic interferon alpha, or both; randomized comparative trial in chronic severe AA.
Double-blind comparison of topical cyclosporin A vs placebo in AA; treated as RCT though randomization not explicitly stated.
Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled intrapatient (right-left) topical corticosteroid foam trial in moderate–severe AA.
Randomized controlled trial of systemic prednisone taper followed by topical minoxidil vs vehicle in AA.

Epidemiological incidence study; not an RCT.
